column2: that there is a reasonable ground for suspecting
that an offence referred to in section 41 has
been  committed  and  that  evidence  of  the
commission of the offence is to be found at
any  premises  or  in  any  vessel,  vehicle  or
aircraft or with any person; or
that any book, account or other document or
thing  which  ought  to  have  been  produced
during an investigation conducted by it under
this Act and have not been so produced are to
be  found  at  such  premises  or  in  any  such
vehicle, vessel or aircraft or with any person,
